reviews.summary: Correction to batch 004's r1 description: the rare long rows are computed by an OpenMP host worker, not a separate long-row GPU kernel. The SELL kernel explicitly returns for LONG_ROW rows; those rows' entire CSR values/columns are copied to host long-row arrays. `spmvHybrid()` launches SELL for regular rows and executes a host CSR loop for each long row, and the timed `iter < iterations` loop invokes `spmvHybrid()` on every pass. Compiled host code confirms the timed counter encloses SELL stub launches and an outlined GOMP worker whose CSR inner backedge spans the row's CSR end; long-row results are copied into their row slots before gather. Final SASS has only CSR-to-SELL preprocessing and SELL SpMV functions; SELL's guard skips LONG_ROW, as intended, while host worker fills these rows.

source_evidence.claim: Complete source shows MPI row ownership, all runtime controls, SELL packing of regular rows and full CSR packing of long rows, GPU and OpenMP dispatch on every timed repetition, synchronization and complete result merge.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed counter/backedge encloses the SELL launch and GOMP long-row worker; worker assigns long-row IDs, traverses CSR from row begin to end with multiply-add and stores host result.
The only final GPU SpMV kernel is SELL, and its compiled row checks/SELL traversal/store correspond to the regular-row path; CSR-to-SELL conversion is separate and untimed.

reviews.notes: Batch 004's source claim that long rows use a separate CSR device kernel was incorrect. This version supersedes that ID entry only; it is a CPU hybrid split, which is legitimate.

reviews.summary: Rank blocks and per-GPU worker row slices rebase CSR delimiters to their own nonzero ranges. Each worker pre-captures GRAPH_BATCH launches when iterations permit, replays the graph floor(iterations/GRAPH_BATCH) times, then issues scalar launches until its counter reaches iterations. Thus graph batching plus remainder preserves requested launch count; SASS variants are selected by average row length and each processes full CSR rows. Worker synchronizes after output copies.

source_evidence.claim: Per-worker row/nnz setup, graph capture of fixed launch batch, timed graph/remainder loops and output copies.

compiled_evidence.claim: The clocked main function launches the timed outlined worker and gathers results before the end clock. Untimed graph capture has an actual 32-launch host backedge. The complete timed worker retains graph replays with increments of 32, scalar remainder launches for all six group-size dispatches, output copies and synchronization.
All six templated final kernels include row guards and full CSR traversal/reduction/store for each possible selected group.

reviews.notes: CUDA graph capture/upload and sparse partition setup occur outside timing; every replay contains 32 actual SpMV launches, and scalar launches cover the remainder. This is batching, not omitted work.
